title: Cardinal Pascual de Aragón to Pedro de Aragón (BNE Mss/2043), syllabic cipher S1, p. 0496: key partial by our protocol, read in part against the contemporary margin

documents.shelfmark: Madrid, BNE Mss/2043 (olim G. 85; BNE Digital, BDH bdh0000042925), PDF view 0496, left and right pages (about f. 493)
documents.date: undated on the part transcribed; c. 1676-1677 by its content
documents.route: Cardinal Pascual de Aragón, archbishop of Toledo -> his brother Pedro Antonio de Aragón

places.from: Toledo (the cardinal's see; not read on this page)
places.to: Pedro de Aragón (place not stated on the page)

plaintext.source: A contemporary decipherment is written in the margin facing the cipher lines (left margin of the left page; right page, line starts caught in the binding). An interlinear clear on the right page was not read.

transcription.source: BNE Mss/2043, BNE Digital (images not reproduced)
transcription.notes: Cipher column only, transcribed after the key was frozen and hashed before the margin was read; pale ink and crossing interlinear writing; 7 doubtful signs as A|B, 3 illegible.

system.summary: Mixed syllabic cipher (S1): 1-2 digit numbers for letters and syllables (13 e, 16 a, 25 que, 22 se, 21 pa, 26-30 sa..su, 31-35 ma..mu, 36-40 ta..tu), letter-shaped signs read with a shifted consonant (te = de, ga = la, po/go = no, pa = na, ca = ua), simple signs (a = n, + = s, x = r, ø = o, a+ = l, r = u, ue = h), a few 3-digit numbers (281 = V.E.) and nulls.
system.notes: Sign shapes of the 6/10/20 family and of 21/24/28/31 settled by Brice Dudout on blind shape plates (shape chosen, no values shown).

prior_solution.where: The contemporary margin decipherment on the page is the reading of the time, so the content is not new. No edition or study of these cipher letters found (web searches, 4-5 Nov 2026); nothing at Cryptiana (Tomokiyo); no DECODE record found; no target, lead or catalogue entry for Mss/2043, Pascual de Aragón or Villahermosa on origin/main (checked by the GitHub API, b4e99d6f, 5 Nov 2026), apart from our issue #254. Not opened: Maura, Vida y reinado de Carlos II, and studies of Valenzuela and Juan José, which may quote the cardinal's letters in clear.

conditions.human_role: Brice Dudout downloaded the scans, set the rules (protocols and amendments hashed before each step, one held-out page per key, thresholds fixed in advance), answered the blind shape plates (shape seen only) and agreed the declared second run. AI agents transcribed, learned the keys, measured, read and wrote up. No human palaeographer checked the transcription or the reading.
models: Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic), agents run by Brice Dudout

solution.what: Volume screened on contact sheets; S1 identified; training pairs transcribed (margins of views 0138-0139 and 0484-0485; ten letters of views 0318-0355 paired with the 'Descifrado' gathering).
Keys learned by EM alignment on the training pairs only and frozen by SHA-256; each measured once on a fresh held-out page (C01-C07: see validation.txt).

Blind shape plates answered by Brice Dudout: 6/10/20 are three forms (20 = c, 10 = i, 6 = p); 24b and 31b are one sign, the existing 21; one 24 on view 0344 is 28. Key CLE_C08c learned on 14 pairs and frozen; health check passed.

One measurement on held-out p. 0496, declared rerun after an input-format error (run 1: 0.392 vs 0.344, failed; run 2, official: 0.742 vs 0.422 for the best of 200 shuffled keys, margin +0.320, under the 0.85 threshold).
Decryption cut into words and read against the margin: 95 words, 41 certain, 41 probable, 13 restored (86%); the cipher corrects the margin in three places (juzgo, Melgar, estado).

outcome.method: key recovered based on adjacent plaintext
outcome.method_basis: The key was learned from the contemporary decipherments of other letters of the same volume (margins and the 'Descifrado' gathering) and measured once on p. 0496, whose margin decipherment is the reading of the time. The content is the margin's (existing); the transcription, the key as a table and three corrections of the margin are the contribution.
outcome.fraction_read_source: Daniel's rule (certain + probable; restored words not counted), counted by script on the alignment of the official measurement: 95 margin words, 41 certain, 41 probable, 13 restored = 82/95 = 86.3%.

validation.notes: Contributor's pre-registered held-out test (not docs/_validate.py): key frozen before p. 0496 was opened, cipher hashed before its margin was read, one page. Run 1 0.392 vs 0.344 (failed; 7 note lines of the clear file were scored as clear, an input-format error); run 2, agreed and declared before launch as the official result with no third run: 0.742 of characters vs 0.422 for the best of 200 shuffled keys (margin +0.320), M5 0.281 vs 0.186. Thresholds fixed in advance: >= 0.85 and >= control + 0.30. Margin met, absolute threshold missed: partial by our protocol. An earlier key measured once on p. 0504 left: 0.778 vs 0.424 (partial).

credits.note: the decipherment written in the margin of p. 0496 at the time, and the margins and 'Descifrado' gathering of the volume, from which the key was learned

cipher of p. 0496 and its margin transcribed; key S1 (CLE_C08c, partial by our protocol) learned on 14 pairs and measured once on a held-out page; decryption read and translated; three margin words corrected by the cipher (juzgo, Melgar, estado)

texts.label: PDF view 0496, left and right pages: cipher with its contemporary margin
texts.summary: On the suspension of arms by which the Sicily affair would be put in the Pope's hands, and the resolution of Carpio; the orders to Your Excellency as they stand at Melgar; Medellín; the writer fears Medina, kept in this state by discontent, and the conferences of Oropesa; Valencia (or Valenzuela) is still very entrenched.

reading_review.note: Read as sentences 5 Nov 2026 against the contemporary margin: one reading by an AI agent only (Brice Dudout answered the shape plates, not the reading). The decryption construes as Spanish sentences once cut into words, but with gaps: 41 certain, 41 probable, 13 restored of 95 words (86%), so read in part.

outcome.notes: The page was deciphered at the time (margin), so we claim no solution. New here: the transcription, the S1 key as a reusable table (partial by our protocol), and three places where the cipher corrects the margin. Scope, not gaps: the interlinear clear on the right page was not read and not used, so that the held-out test stayed clean (declared deviation); the other S1 pieces of the volume, the date of the letter and the individuals behind Carpio, Medina, Oropesa and Valencia/Valenzuela are not part of this reading.
